title: Mark Twain a life
author: Powers, Ron
summary:
"In Mark Twain, Ron Powers consummates years of thought and research with a tour de force on the life of our culture's founding father, re-creating the 19th century's vital landscapes and tumultuous events while restoring the human being at their center. He offers Sam Clemens as he lived, breathed, and wrote - drawing heavily on the preserved viewpoints of the people who knew him best (especially the great William Dean Howells, his most admiring friend and literary co-conspirator), and on the annals of the American 19th century that he helped shape. Powers's prose rivals Mark Twain's own in its blend of humor, telling detail, and flights of lyricism. With the assistance of the Mark Twain Project at Berkeley, he has been able to draw on thousands of letters and notebook entries, many only recently discovered. 
"It is hard to imagine a life that encompassed more of its times. Sam Clemens left his frontier boyhood in Missouri for a life on the Mississippi during the golden age of steamboats. He skirted the western theater of the Civil War before taking off for an uproarious drunken newspaper career in the Nevada of the Wild West. As his fame as a humorist and lecturer spread around the country, he took the East Coast by storm, witnessing the extremes of wealth and poverty of New York City and the Gilded Age (which he named). He traveled to Europe on the first American pleasure cruise and revitalized the prim genre of travel writing. He wooed and won his lifelong devoted wife, yet quietly pined for the girl who was his first crush and whom he would re-encounter many decades later. He invented and invested in get-rich-quick schemes. He became the toast of Europe and a celebrity who toured the globe.

title: 9 september
summary:
Sinopsis: ‘9 SEPTEMBER’, sebuah filem romantik komedi mengisahkan bagaimana Nia (Fasha Sandha) perempuan yang berperwatakan kasar dan ganas tetapi mempunyai wajah yang sangat comel ditingggalkan oleh kekasihnya. Sejak dari itu dia menyimpan dendam terhadap lelaki. Mangsanya adalah seorang lelaki bernama Kogi (Pierre Andre), Kogi adalah seorang lelaki yang baik dan jujur. Dia dilihat sebagai seorang yang sangat senang dibuli oleh Nia.

Kali pertama mereka bertemu apabila Nia tersalah masuk ke rumah Kogi. Selepas itu banyak kebetulan mereka bertemu, walaupun Kogi selalu dibuli namun dia sentiasa menunjukan sikap seorang lelaki sejati. Dia dilihat seperti ‘malaikat’ yang menjaga Nia dalam keadaan apa jua sekali pun. Lama-kelaman mereka seperti hampir jatuh cinta sesama sendiri sehinggalah satu hari Andrian, kekasih Nia kembali kepangkuannya.

Tidak dapat dinafikan Nia sebenarnya masih mencintai kekasih lamanya. Namun kasih sayangnya kali ini tidak setebal dulu, Nia kadang kala memikirkan Kogi. Begitu juga Kogi yang sentiasa mengalah kepada Nia. Sehinggalah pada satu hari Nia terbang ke Tokyo mengikut kekasihnya ke sana selama satahun, setelah pulang ke Malaysia, Nia terus mencari Kogi, namun gagal. Apabila Nia menemui Kogi, sesuatu yang sangat mengejutkan telah berlaku dan sangat sukar diterima Nia.

Kogi terus membawa diri ke satu pulau terpencil di mana dia dan Nia pernah terperangkap di sana. Nia terus mencari walaupun berita yang telah diterimanya itu sangat sukar ditelan. Apabila Nia mencari Kogi di pulau itu, peristiwa yang lebih mengejutkan telah berlaku. Peristiwa tersebut mengubah sepenuhnya kehidupan Nia. Sehingga Nia berkahwin dengan Andrian, Nia masih mencari Kogi. Apakah kesudahannya dan bersatukah Nia dan Kogi akhirnya? Segalanya hanya terjawab pada “9 SEPTEMBER”.

summary: Ye Yizheng had a secret. No one knows that he has a crusher in his head that crushes all the knowledge he hears in his head. This makes him different from the rest of the world, and gives him the nickname ‘Stupid Dummy’. Luckily for him, there was a girl who stood up for him. She becomes his beacon of light, clearing away the darkness and keeping him motivated. One day, he accidentally mastered the method of memorising numbers by making up stories with the characters in the manga, thus unveiling a corner of the fantasy world. With his own ‘sword’ in hand, he embarks on a journey of adventure that will take him ever forward!
